title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → AlumniProfile
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Constituent base: preferred class year, constituent status. Anchors the profile.
Constituent categories. Filter to alumni categories (ALUM, ALND, and local codes) to decide who gets a profile.
Degrees on the advancement record, including degrees from other schools. Primary degree for this institution comes from here or from SHRDGMR.
Employment history: employer (as a PIDM), position, dates, SIC code. The row without an end date is current.
Activities: volunteer roles, mentoring, boards, clubs. FLAG: activity codes are local.
Memberships, including alumni association membership and expiry.
Event attendance from Banner General Events.

notes: AlumniProfile is career and engagement data, not giving data. It links to Constituent through constituent_ref and never copies giving fields. Per ACM-SPECIAL-009, don't bulk-join AlumniProfile to solicitation lists without steward review. Not an education record (is_education_record = false), but stays confidential.
